quiz.q: Could you give me a ______ when you arrive at the airport?
quiz.why: give sb. a call 给某人打电话，这里 call 是名词，a 后面用单数 call（#233 call 的课堂笔记：give me a call = call me）。
常见误区。news 是不可数名词，前面不能加 a，所以用 What + 形容词 + 不可数名词（#243 car 的例句：What terrible news it is!）。

quiz.q: We had to stay at home. The football match ______ because of the heavy rain.
quiz.why: 比赛是“被”取消的，又发生在过去，用一般过去时的被动语态 was cancelled（#240 cancel 的例句：the flight was cancelled）。

quiz.q: Please be ______ (care)! The floor is wet.
quiz.placeholder: 用 care 的适当形式
quiz.why: be 后面接形容词：care → careful 小心的（#245 care 的词形拓展，课堂笔记 Be careful!）。

quiz.q: Tom is a ______ (care) boy. He often makes mistakes in his homework.
quiz.placeholder: 用 care 的适当形式
quiz.why: 经常出错，说明他“粗心”：careless 粗心的，-less 表示“没有”（#248 careless）。careful 的反义词就是 careless。

quiz.q: Who will ______ your cat when you travel to Canada?
quiz.why: 旅行时有人“照顾”猫，用 take care of（= care for）。care about 是“关心、在乎”，be careful with 是“小心对待”（#245 care 的常用词组）。

quiz.q: Lucy was born in Toronto. She is a ______ (Canada) girl.
quiz.placeholder: 用 Canada 的适当形式
quiz.why: 修饰 girl 要用形容词 Canadian 加拿大的（#238 Canada 的词形拓展），首字母大写。Canadian 也可以作名词“加拿大人”。

quiz.q: Please keep ______. The doctor will be here soon.
quiz.why: keep + 形容词，表示“保持某种状态”：keep calm 保持冷静（#234 calm 的课堂笔记）。同理 keep active and healthy（第 1 批 #13）。

quiz.q: Little Tom was sleeping while everybody else was listening carefully. 这句可以省略成 … while listening carefully。
quiz.why: 迁移 + 误区。while 后面只有在主语和主句相同时，才能省略“主语 + be”：Be careful while (you're) getting off the train（#246）。这句里睡觉的是 Tom，听讲的是 everybody else，主语不同，不能省（#247 carefully）。

quiz.q: Read the questions ______ (careful) before you answer them.
quiz.placeholder: 用 careful 的适当形式
quiz.why: 修饰动词 read 要用副词：careful（adj.）→ carefully（adv.）仔细地（#247 carefully）。反义词 carelessly。

quiz.q: The weather is fine. Shall we go ______ in the forest this weekend?
quiz.why: go camping 去露营（#236 camp 的课堂笔记），同类的还有 go swimming、go shopping。

quiz.q: This sofa is soft and very ______ (comfort). I like sitting on it.
quiz.placeholder: 用 comfort 的适当形式
quiz.why: very 后面要形容词：comfort（n. & v.）→ comfortable（adj.）舒适的（#236 camp 的课堂笔记）。

ex.en: He grows [cabbages] on his farm.
ex.zh: 他在自家农场里种卷心菜。

ntip: on his farm：“在农场”用介词 on

ex.en: We went into the [café] for coffee and dessert yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们到咖啡馆喝了咖啡，吃了点心。

ntip: café 来自法语，e 上面有一撇；默写时写 cafe 也算对

ex.en: Mike's mother bought him a big [cake] on his birthday.
ex.zh: 迈克生日那天，他妈妈给他买了一个大蛋糕。

senses.zh: 打电话给……；称呼；取名；呼唤；喊；叫

ex.en: Please [call] me when you get home.
ex.zh: 你到家时请给我打个电话。

ex.en: Computers are super calculators; we usually [call] them electronic brains.
ex.zh: 电脑是超级计算器，我们通常称它们为电子大脑。

ex.en: Rafe Esquith is [called] the most interesting classroom teacher in the U.S.A.
ex.zh: 雷夫·艾斯奎斯被称为美国最有趣的课堂老师。

ex.en: The charity [called] for immediate action to help homeless pets.
ex.zh: 该慈善机构呼吁立即采取行动帮助无家可归的宠物。

ex.en: I gave him a phone [call] yesterday.
ex.zh: 我昨天给他打电话了。

nph.zh: 给我打电话（call 是名词，= call me）
被称为……（后面接名词或名词词组）

ex.en: The sea is now [calm].
ex.zh: 海现在平静了。

ex.en: I think everybody should just [calm] down.
ex.zh: 我想每个人都应该冷静下来。

ntip: calm 里的 l 不发音
I think (that) everybody should …：think 后面省略了 that

ex.en: Now a [camera] does not cost much and most young people are certainly able to pay for it.
ex.zh: 现在照相机花费不多，所以绝大多数年轻人都能买得起。

ex.en: Shall we join in the Green World Summer [Camp]?
ex.zh: 我们参加绿色世界夏令营好吗？

ex.en: They brought all the necessary supplies to [camp] comfortably in the wilderness.
ex.zh: 他们带了必要的物资，以便在野外能舒适地露营。

nph.zh: n. 供应；supplies 生活物资
adj. 舒适的（comfortably adv. 舒适地）

ex.en: My son likes reading stories. Now he [can] tell a story as well as his sister.
ex.zh: 我儿子喜欢阅读故事。现在，他的故事可以讲得和他姐姐一样好。

ex.en: This [can] holds five litres of water.
ex.zh: 这个容器可装 5 升水。

ntip: This can holds …：这里 can 是名词“罐子”，所以动词 holds 要加 -s

ex.en: [Canada] has ten provinces.
ex.zh: 加拿大有 10 个省。

ex.en: My brother has studied in a university in [Canada] for three years. He will come back to China next week.
ex.zh: 我哥哥在加拿大一所大学学习了 3 年。他将于下周回中国。

der.zh: adj. 加拿大的；加拿大人的；n. 加拿大人

ex.en: He went to Canada several years ago. Now he is a [Canadian] citizen.
ex.zh: 几年前他去了加拿大。他现在是加拿大公民。

ex.en: The [Canadian] won the championship in this event at the Olympics.
ex.zh: 那位加拿大人赢得了奥运会这个项目的冠军。

nph.zh: 赢（过去式和过去分词都是 won）

ex.en: We needn't hurry all the way to the airport; the flight was [cancelled] because of the foggy weather.
ex.zh: 我们不必急着去机场，因为有雾，航班被取消了。

nph.zh: adj. 有雾的（fog n. 雾，双写 g 加 -y）

ex.en: Beijing is the [capital] of China.
ex.zh: 北京是中国的首都。

ex.en: The [capital] of Hainan Province is Haikou.
ex.zh: 海南省的省会是海口。

senses.zh: 船长；（尤指运动队的）队长

ex.en: Tom Zhu is a [captain].
ex.zh: 汤姆·朱是一位船长。

nph.zh: 美国队长（电影角色名，captain 放在前面）

ex.en: What terrible news it is! Three people died in the [car] accident.
ex.zh: 多么可怕的消息！有 3 人在车祸中丧生。

ex.en: A nice [card] was chosen for his mother by John on Mother's Day.
ex.zh: 在母亲节，约翰为妈妈选了一张漂亮的贺卡。

ex.en: Without great [care], the old man's condition may become even worse.
ex.zh: 如果不多加照料，这位老人的状况可能会变得更糟。

ex.en: I don't [care] whether he comes or not.
ex.zh: 我不介意他来不来。

der.zh: 粗心的；不小心的；不仔细的

ntip: care for（照顾）= take care of
even + 比较级：even worse 更糟
I don't care …：笔记里把“介意”改成了“在乎”，意思更贴切

ex.en: Be [careful] while getting off the train. The ground is wet.
ex.zh: 下车时要小心，地面是湿的。

ntip: while getting off = while (you're) getting off：主语相同，省略了“主语 + be”（同第 2 批 #131）

ex.en: Little Tom was sleeping while everybody else was listening to the teacher [carefully].
ex.zh: 小汤姆在睡觉，而其他人都在认真听老师讲课。

ntip: while 后面的主语 everybody else 和主句的 Tom 不同，所以 everybody else was 不能省略

senses.zh: 粗心的；不小心的；不仔细的

ex.en: It's known to all that [careless] drivers are a danger to both themselves and others.
ex.zh: 大家都知道，粗心的司机对自己和他人都是危险的。

nph.zh: adj. 危险的（danger n. 危险）
